verdict.rationale: Twilio documents a real-time feed of all its events streamed to multiple destinations, and a hands-on user reports using Twilio's voicemail-to-webhook with transcription. However, the pack never explicitly documents registrable HTTP webhook callbacks for call and message status events. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on registering webhook URLs for call/message events, payload and signature details, and documentation that event-stream destinations include HTTP webhooks.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems

citations.quote: Get a unified, real-time feed of all Twilio events and interactions streamed to multiple destinations.
